name: Narita Makio
source:
Owner and practitioner at a massage parlor.
He has a piercing gaze and gives the impression of being a man with angular features, but his gentle demeanor—which contrasts sharply with this image—makes him very popular with his clients.

He has absolute confidence in his erotic massage techniques and even feels he has a mission: to seduce women by putting them to good use.
